caption: The drawing is divided into two main rectangular sections, both bordered in red and featuring stylized human faces with large, colorful wings. The upper section contains a winged face at the top center, with pink cheeks, red lips, and dark eyes, set within a circular pink collar. The wings extend horizontally and are decorated with pink and brown tones and black dots. Below this, a large, dark brown heart shape with floral decorations in blue, red, and green encloses German text written in red ink. On either side of the heart, there are tall, symmetrical flowers colored in red, pink, green, yellow, and blue, with green leafy stems surrounded by other smaller floral motifs. The background of this section is a light tan with fine floral detailing. The lower section features another stylized face with curly hair at the center, framed by large, multi-colored wings composed of yellow, pink, and green sections outlined in black. Beneath the face and wings, there is Gothic-style German text in black and red ink, with some additional handwriting in faint pencil below. The background of the lower section is plain and light tan. The entire drawing is set against an unadorned cream background, with no other objects present.
title: Manuscript and Miniature
